items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And he was around Buffalo at the time, you know, when we were around there.

ctx.x: Al Sears sounded good there. He played a thing in there, "Happy Go Lucky," or something, and the music that he put behind him fit him, fit that tone. Al sounded better with that band than I ever heard him in my life. And he was around Buffalo at the time, you know, when we were around there.
I wasn't here then, I don't think, when he -- in fact I think Stanley and I had married and I was in England.
